study type: retrospective analysis of health insurance claims data
cohort: Newborns and infants with and without cCMV diagnosis
finding: Congenital cytomegalovirus infection is associated with substantially higher healthcare costs, both at birth and during the first year of life, compared to infants without cCMV infection.
mod_finding: Newborns with cCMVd accrued costs at birth averaging 1.5 to 2.1 times greater than control infants for cesarean and vaginal deliveries.
